title: Global_AB_stylized_fs_imagery
publisher: UN OCHA Field Information Services Section (FISS), hosted at gis.unocha.org
lineage: Publisher item metadata: 'based on United Nations Geospatial WORLD STYLIZED Datasets (UN Geodata Simplified)'; credits 'UN Geospatial, OCHA FISS'; prepared in the context of the UN Administrative Instruction on the 'Guidelines for the Publication of Maps'

coverage.evidence: gbl_* (global) layers; service fullExtent spans the full Web Mercator world; publisher snippet describes world-size geoinfographics and global reference data

crs.export: EPSG:4326 via ArcGIS REST outSR=4326, verified with f=geojson

scale_note: Publisher states: 'The scale is unspecific for the United Nations Geodata simplified and is suitable for generalized world maps and web-maps'; the 1:25M tag on the lakes layer is a publisher scale hint, not a dataset-wide certification. Boundary geometry is intentionally generalized.
attribution: Boundaries: UN Geospatial, OCHA FISS (Global_AB_stylized_fs_imagery, UN Geodata Simplified)
disclaimer: The publisher dataset is a simplified/generalized world reference, not an official UN map product for boundary delimitation. Any map produced from it must not be presented as an official UN map. UN map use/credit guidance applies.

license_state.un_map_permissions_reviewed: https://www.un.org/geospatial/es/node/741 (use/credit/derived-map guidance; not an automatic geodata redistribution licence)
license_state.local_use: Downloaded copy kept in gitignored local cache for offline development rendering within this project
license_state.redistribution: unresolved - do not redistribute data files or claim production clearance

export_method.protocol: ArcGIS REST query, f=geojson, outSR=4326, where=1=1, outFields=*, ordered by objectid_1 with resultOffset pagination
export_method.capabilities_observed: Query,Sync,Extract; maxRecordCount=2000; geojson export verified despite supportedQueryFormats listing JSON only
export_method.completeness_rule: per-layer official count (returnCountOnly) must equal collected unique feature count; pagination continues until short page

country_land.note: Neutral land fill only; no labels or thematic country colors. Added after visual review showed line-only regional crops lacked a clear land/ocean cue.

boundary_lines.type_mapping_source: layer 105 renderer classes + iteminfo layer description (BDYTYP field codes), fetched 2026-09-22

lakes.note: publisher lake layer currently contains only the Caspian Sea; included as the optional light water layer, no coverage claim beyond that

layers_deliberately_excluded.region_layers: service layers 103, 106, 108, 109, 110 (populated places, SDGA/intermediary/geographic regions) - outside MVP basemap scope
layers_deliberately_excluded.admin_level_1: not requested (A-15 excludes admin-1 from MVP)

verification_log.full_export_probe: single-page geojson export of layer 105 returned 743/743 unique objectid_1 values on 2026-09-22
verification_log.agol_item_note: serviceItemId a14849e4729b48f3a4c992228d40c2a9 is not publicly readable on www.arcgis.com sharing; the service's own info/iteminfo is the canonical item metadata record
